notes: Built only from the ICICI Emeralde product page. Reward point value (₹0.25) and no reward caps come from the cardholder. The page does not state which categories (fuel, rent, wallet loads, government, EMI) earn no points or don't count toward the fee waiver. Those need the MITC / T&C PDFs. Fees are shown before GST.

sources.title: Cardholder's own information (Card Manager chat, 9 Oct 2026)
